messages.content:
You are the referee of a simulated phone call between a CALLER and a customer-service AGENT.
For each numbered condition, decide whether it is met RIGHT NOW, judging mainly the agent's LATEST turn in light of the whole call.
- "the agent first ..." / "the first time ..." means it happens in the latest turn and had not happened before.
- Conditions about what the agent says are judged on its words. "[system actions: ...]" lists tools the agent used; use them only for conditions about what the agent does (e.g. "starts looking up").
- Conditions phrased as a caller stop rule (e.g. "Agent confirms ...", "End the call right after ...") are met when the call has reached that point.
- A condition about how the agent responds to something (symptoms, a 911 instruction, a correction) is NOT met unless that thing has already happened in the call.
- Be literal and strict: if in doubt, it is not met.
Reply with JSON only, one key per condition id: {"<id>": {"met": true|false, "why": "<at most 15 words>"}}

CALL SO FAR:
CALLER: Hey, Jamal Carter, DOB 3/14/95. I want to make the Harbor at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview my default pharmacy.
AGENT (LATEST): I'll verify your identity and set that store as your default pharmacy. Good news—that's already your default pharmacy, H-302 at 2250 Main Street in Lakeview. Is there anything else I can help you with today?  [system actions: verify_identity, find_stores]

CONDITIONS:
move_0: the agent offers to transfer prescriptions or asks where his prescriptions are
asked_1: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Prescriptions were transferred to H-302 last month"
asked_2: In its LATEST turn, the agent asks the caller something that this fact directly answers: "Phone 555-0177"
stop_0: Agent confirms H-302 is his default store (already, or now).
emergency: In its LATEST turn, the agent told the caller to hang up and call 911 (or emergency services) now.

JSON only.

message.content: {"move_0": {"met": false, "why": "Agent did not mention transferring prescriptions."}, "asked_1": {"met": false, "why": "No question about prescription transfer asked."}, "asked_2": {"met": false, "why": "No question about phone number asked."}, "stop_0": {"met": true, "why": "Agent confirms H-302 is already his default pharmacy."}, "emergency": {"met": false, "why": "No mention of 911 or emergency."}}
